content:
Maria Gonzalez: Quick heads-up for folks joining the Welcome Sync tomorrow at 9:00 AM PT / 5:00 PM BST — I just updated the calendar event so the Zoom link is explicit. Can everyone check their invite and confirm it shows 'Zoom - Redwood Welcome' (not a Google Meet placeholder)?
Alex Kim: I see Zoom on mine, no passcode. :thumbsup:
Jamal Singh: Mine shows a Meet link instead. I imported the .ics into Apple Calendar earlier — could that cause it?
Maria Gonzalez: Yep, Apple Calendar sometimes replaces the video URL when importing ICS. If you imported, try opening the event in Google Calendar web and click "Copy to my calendar" or accept the updated invite that I just re-sent.
Jamal Singh: Thanks — re-accepting fixed it. Zoom now shows.
Leah Wong: Recording note: we'll record and drop the link into #new-hires/resources within 30 minutes after the session. If you can't make it, watch there. Also adding the direct recording link in the event description so it's easier to find.
Alex Kim: Any passcode for the Zoom recording? My company Zoom sometimes blocks downloads without the passcode.
Maria Gonzalez: No recording passcode — recordings are internal. If your browser asks, DM me and I'll share an expiring link.
HR Ops: If anyone still has issues with calendar times (e.g., appears as a different hour), include what OS/calendar app you're using and your timezone in the reply and we'll adjust the invite method. Common gotcha: iOS will display the event in the device timezone if you imported an ICS.
Jamal Singh: macOS 13.5, Apple Calendar, timezone set to IST (UTC+5:30) — the event showed 9:30 for me until I re-accepted.
Maria Gonzalez: That explains it. For mac users: delete the imported event, then accept the invite from Gmail web so it attaches the live event link.
Onboard Bot: Calendar invite updated by Maria Gonzalez — Zoom link corrected.
Leah Wong: Also adding an agenda to the event: 1) Quick intros (15m) 2) Product & org overview (20m) 3) Setup blockers + who-to-ask (10m) 4) Next steps + resources (15m). If you have blocking setup items, drop them here now so we can triage during the session.
Alex Kim: FYI I had an MFA hiccup with SSO earlier — if others hit login prompts during setup, ping #devex or DM me.
Jamal Singh: One last ask: will there be an attendee list in the invite? Want to confirm which cohort I'm in.
Maria Gonzalez: Yes — attendee list updated. You're in Cohort B. I'll pin the cohort roster in #new-hires and attach the final ICS after the meeting for calendar-friendly imports.
Leah Wong: For folks who prefer an ICS: when you download the ICS from the event description, import it into Google Calendar (web) rather than directly into desktop apps to avoid swapping links.
Alex Kim: Thanks for sorting this! See you tomorrow. :wave:
Maria Gonzalez: Thanks everyone — see you all then, and please holler if anything else shows up weirdly in your calendar.
